title: Durable file effect with crash reconciliation
objective: Create a content-addressed report, survive a crash after the file write, reconcile the effect, and finish only after independent verification.
acceptance: The mission is reconstructed with the same stable ID after restart.
The file effect occurs exactly once when the destination supports hash reconciliation.
The receipt records persisted intent before execution and confirmed observation after reconciliation.
The artifact is recoverable by SHA-256 without carrying its full contents in active context.
A separate worker process applies the effect and exits at the injected crash boundary.
A controlled browser probe observes the recovered report and records its own receipt.
A verifier distinct from the executor observes the file and approves every completion criterion.
